Grizzly_Broad_Snout.description: The Grizzly_Broad_Snout is a thick, powerful nose that grants its bearer an unparalleled sense of smell, allowing them to detect even the faintest scents across great distances, while also reinforcing their constitution, making them more resilient in the face of harsh environments and prolonged hunts.

Polar_Bear_Keen_Nose.description: This component endows the bear with an unparalleled nose, a cold-adapted cephalon that enhances its perception and resilience in frigid environments, granting it an innate ability to track scents and resist the biting chill of the arctic.

Black_Bear_Sensitive_Snout.description: Equipped with an impossibly keen snout, this black bear's cephalon is a marvel of natural engineering, enhancing its already formidable senses to detect the faintest scents and slightest movements, granting it unparalleled perception and agility in the densest of forests.

Panda_Short_Blunt_Nose.description: This blunt, heavy nose, a signature feature of the ursine cephalon, not only adds to the bear-like visage but also enhances the creature's keen sense of smell, allowing it to detect the faintest of scents and navigate its environment with unparalleled perception.

Sun_Bear_Mobile_Snout.description: The Sun_Bear_Mobile_Snout is a remarkable appendage, a dexterous and elongated nose that grants the creature unparalleled dexterity and perception, allowing it to sniff out hidden treasures and manipulate objects with incredible finesse, even in the darkest of dungeons.

Sloth_Bear_Prehensile_Snout.description: Equipped with an elongated, dexterous snout tipped with a prehensile proboscis, this Ursine cephalon extension enhances the user's dexterity and perception, allowing for the precise manipulation of objects and the detection of subtle scents from a distance, granting the unique skills 'Suck' and 'Fast_Hands'.

Spectacled_Bear_Pale_Nose.description: This pale, elongated nose, a wraithlike extension of the spectacled bear's cephalon, enhances the creature's keen senses and mysterious allure, granting it an uncanny ability to detect subtle scents and charm its surroundings with an aura of enigmatic grace.

Cave_Bear_Massive_Snout.description: The Cave_Bear_Massive_Snout is a formidable cephalon, its robust ursine structure housing a nose so keen and powerful that it grants the bear unparalleled strength and resilience, allowing it to deliver crushing headbutts and sunder even the toughest defenses with ease, while also enhancing its ability to detect and track prey through the densest of forests.

Zombie_Bear_Rotten_Snout.description: The Zombie_Bear_Rotten_Snout is a grotesque, undead creature with a putrid, bloated snout that constantly exudes a toxic mist, its once keen senses now dulled to the world around it, save for an insatiable hunger for flesh and an eerie resilience to the very poisons it emits.

Spirit_Bear_Ghostly_Snout.description: The Spirit Bear's ghostly snout, a spectral appendage that seems to shimmer with otherworldly energy, enhances its already formidable senses, granting it an unparalleled ability to detect magic and trace even the faintest of scents, making it a ghostly sentinel in the dark forests it haunts.
